response.sql:
WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rfistat,
    AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY rfistat
), above_baseline AS (
  SELECT
    rfistat,
    avg_modindex,
    AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS baseline
  FROM status_averages
)
SELECT
  rfistat,
  avg_modindex,
  avg_modindex - baseline AS above_baseline,
  avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM above_baseline
WHERE avg_modindex > baseline
ORDER BY rfistat;

assumptions.assumption: The NULL `rfistat` group is included as its own status group. Groups whose `modindex` values are all NULL have a NULL average and are excluded from the baseline and results because SQL averages ignore NULL values.
